about_the_game:
Become a mysterious white cat and step into an unknown world of fantasy to uncover the forgotten truth.

Magicat is a 2D anime-style RPG that blends light-action Roguelike elements with a fantasy adventure experience.
You will play as Layla, a small white cat who awakens in a hidden paradise known as Septora Valley. Guided by butterfly spirits, you’ll explore a vast and mysterious world, wield dazzling magic, and confront heretical humans who have suddenly invaded.
On a journey filled with courage, warmth, and mystery, you will gradually unveil the secrets of the valley—and rediscover your true self.

【Key Features】

✨ Ever-Changing “Magic Evolution” System
• The core gameplay mechanic! Harness the power of magical evolution medals to completely alter your spell forms, attributes, and effects.
• Combine elemental advantages to craft your strategy—will you strike with light magic against darkness, or unleash thunder to shatter water-type foes? Every battle is a new challenge.

⚡ Fast-Paced & Strategic Real-Time Combat
• Enjoy smooth and exhilarating combat! Master precise dodges and positioning while pairing powerful medals and spells for victory.
• Experience light Roguelike elements that grant temporary magic and random treasures—every run feels fresh and unpredictable.
• Unleash devastating ultimate attacks and end fierce battles in the most spectacular way possible!

🌙 A World of Day and Night Cycles
• By day, Septora Valley is a vibrant and breathtaking paradise for exploration—gather resources, enhance equipment, and advance the story.
• When night falls, the world plunges into eerie darkness! Enemies grow stronger, fiercer, and more aggressive. Only the bravest Sleepy Cat, Layla, dares to face the terrors of the night and claim rare rewards.

🗺️ Explore a Vast Anime-Inspired World
• Journey through 13 unique regions of Septora Valley—from lush forests and open plains to rugged mountains and ancient ruins.
• Enjoy a bright and vivid 2.5D anime-style world with dynamic lighting and immersive environmental sounds—like stepping into a living animated film.
• Search every corner for hidden chests, upgrade materials, and powerful magic spellbooks.

📖 An Enchanting and Mysterious Story
• Follow Layla the Sleepy Cat as she unravels the secrets of Septora Valley, the reason behind the human invasion, and the mystery of her own origin.
• Face off against multiple challenging bosses—and one secret, immensely powerful hidden boss that will truly test your skill and determination.

【About Us】

Created by a small three-person indie team who overcame countless challenges, Magicat is our heartfelt tribute to the worlds of fantasy adventure and anime-style storytelling.
Though small in scale, we are driven by passion—to craft a world that is both beautiful and challenging, emotional and mysterious.
We can’t wait to meet you in Septora Valley!

Add Magicat to your wishlist now and begin this one-of-a-kind feline adventure!🐾

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
